study_type_evidence.quote: plasma concentrations and pharmacokinetics of anti-VEGF PCC agents were studied in groups of 24 mice after IV or IP administration
Human plasma was pre-warmed at 37°C for 5 min, followed by addition of 5 µM AnchorV or Bi-LV
The Bi-LV was pre-incubated with pooled mouse liver microsomes (male CD-1, 0.3 mg/mL) in phosphate buffer (pH 7.4)

in_vivo_species.strain_sex_age: not reported for the PK groups (experimental details referred to Supporting Information Tables S2-S4)
in_vivo_species.quote: plasma concentrations and pharmacokinetics of anti-VEGF PCC agents were studied in groups of 24 mice after IV or IP administration
in_vivo_species.section: METHODS - Sample collection from mice (parallel sampling)

in_vivo_species.strain_sex_age: NU/J, female, immunocompromised, 6-7 weeks old (microPET imaging and HT-29 xenograft)
in_vivo_species.quote: Female immunocompromised NU/J mice (6–7 weeks old) were obtained from Jackson Laboratory.
in_vivo_species.section: METHODS - MicroPET imaging of non-tumor-bearing mice

ex_vivo_detail: Human plasma stability assay: 5 uM AnchorV or Bi-LV incubated in pre-warmed human plasma at 37 C for 0, 15, 30, 45 and 60 min with HPLC-MS/MS quantification of percent compound remaining. Immunoprecipitation of VEGF from 25% human serum was also performed. Mouse liver microsome stability (a subcellular, NADPH-driven system) was classified in vitro rather than ex vivo.
in_vitro_detail: Mouse liver microsome metabolic stability (pooled male CD-1 microsomes, NADPH-generating system); ELISA/EC50 binding assays against VEGF165; VEGF-VEGFR2 inhibition assays; surface plasmon resonance on Biacore T200; ProteoStat thermal shift aggregation assay; circular dichroism; ISOQUANT isoaspartate detection; HPLC/MALDI-TOF analysis of heated Bi-LPA.

agents.name: Bi-LV (anti-VEGF biligand PCC)
agents.sequence: X-VEPNCDIHVMWEWECFERL-Tz4-lfrew (X = biotin-PEG3 detection label; Tz4 = 1,4-triazole linker; lowercase = D-amino acids; disulfide bridge between the two cysteines cyclizes the anchor)
agents.sequence_source: RESULTS - 'Bi-LV (X-VEPNCDIHVMWEWECFERL-Tz4-lfrew) exhibited a 4.5-fold improvement in EC50 relative to AnchorV'
agents.group_n: groups of 24 mice; blood drawn from three animals per time point
agents.group_n_quote: For IV groups, blood was drawn from each of three animals at the following time points: 3, 10, 30, 60, 120, 240, 360, 1,440 min.
agents.dose_route_quote: studied in groups of 24 mice after IV or IP administration at a single dose rate of 1 or 5 mg/kg body weight, respectively
agents.half_life: 7 min (mean elimination half-life, T1/2, after IV administration)
agents.cmax: not reported (other PK values referred to Supporting Information Table S5)
agents.pk_quote: Following IV administration of Bi-LV, the mean elimination half-life (T1/2) is 7 min, which represents a rapid in vivo clearance of Bi-LV.
agents.pk_section: RESULTS - Anti-VEGF PCC: (In vivo) PK analysis and targeting

concentration_time_figure.caption_quote: (A) Pharmacokinetics profiles of Bi-LV and Tri-LV following a single IV or IP dose in mice.
concentration_time_figure.note: Plasma concentration versus time after a single IV or IP dose in mice. Figure 2D (human plasma) and 2E (mouse liver microsomes) plot percent compound remaining versus time at 37 C, i.e. stability rather than in vivo concentration. Note the body text calls the PK panel 'Figure 3A' while the corresponding caption is tagged bip22934-fig-0004.

bioanalytical_method: Nonvalidated LC-MS/MS (Agilent 1200 HPLC with 5500 Qtrap mass spectrometer) using Angiotensin I as internal standard after solid phase extraction; PK analysis with WinNonlin Professional Edition v5.2
bioanalytical_quote: Concentrations in mouse plasma were determined using a nonvalidated LC-MS/MS assay with Angiotensin I as the internal standard following solid phase extraction.
notes: Only elimination half-life is given in the body text (Bi-LV 7 min IV; Tri-LV 36 min IV); all other PK parameters, including any IP half-lives, Cmax and AUC, are referred to Supporting Information Table S5 and are therefore not reported in the body. No half-life is reported for AnchorV or Tetra-LV. Mouse strain, sex and age for the PK arm are not stated in the body (referred to Tables S2-S4). Sequences use lowercase for D-amino acids as printed in the body. Peptide names are inconsistently capitalised in the body (e.g. 'Bi-Lv', 'Bi-L', 'Tri-Lv').
